rules: Qur'an text must keep exact surah/ayah reference and translation attribution.
Editorial copy must never be presented as a Qur'an verse or hadith.
Hadith Phase 1: Sahih al-Bukhari and/or Sahih Muslim only, verified through Dorar.
A hadith French rendering created by the editorial team must be labelled 'sens en français' unless copied from an approved translation.
Fiqh divergences must be identified as divergences; never convert one opinion into a claimed consensus.
Current visa, access, permit, health or regulatory information must come from an official current source.
Every item must have approved=true before it can enter the publication queue.
The renderer never invents a source, verse number, hadith number, tool URL or factual claim.
The generator may shorten editorial framing, but may not alter Qur'an or hadith wording stored as locked_text=true.
blocked_patterns: texte présenté comme Coran sans verset
